yes.description: `false` if no support at all for C3 Type System.

serTypeInference.description:
If `true` then C3 Sever will omit serializing `type` field where it's value can be inferred from metadata. E.g. if
`true` then referenced objects in serialized representation, e.g. in JSON will skip `type` field.

timeseriesPrivateFields.description: If `true` then C3 Sever will serialize timeseries private field instead of materializing methods like `data()`.

errorTemplate.description:
If `true` then C3 Sever will send error in the form of a template using `C3Error` C3 type. Otherwise errors
will be formatted plain text.

methodDebug.description:
Whether the client is capable of debugging method implementations. If true, all method implementations in the
supported #methodLanguages are delivered, along with metadata for private methods. This allows the method to be
executed locally, even if it would normally be server-only.

title:
Type System Support flags. Typically used by clients to indicate their capabilities. E.g. via `X-C3-Type-Aware`
HTTP header.
name: TypeSystemSupport
